name: bottlerocket-sdk
description: Bottlerocket SDK (bottlerocket-os/bottlerocket-sdk): the toolchain and host tools AWS builds Bottlerocket with. Buildroot 2025.05.1 plus the SDK's five-patch series, x86_64 glibc. Not a firmware image: the build is a cross toolchain and sysroot.
notes: The SDK's defconfigs (copied unchanged into buildroot-external/configs/) pin BR2_PRIMARY_SITE=file:///home/builder with BR2_PRIMARY_SITE_ONLY: its Dockerfile pre-fetches every source there. The fragment turns that off so Buildroot downloads normally; nothing else in the configuration changes. Its Buildroot is the 2025.05.1 release with patches/buildroot/0001-0005 (sysroot and tools-directory controls for binutils and gcc), applied at setup.
